messages:
Maya (Design): sharing a new direction for the spend row — instead of horizontal token chips, propose a vertical compact pill that stacks token count over fiat for a tighter row. keeps totals visible and reduces wrap on narrow columns. mock attached in Figma.
Eric (PM): interesting. primary concern: finance users must find invoice downloads quickly. how would this layout surface the invoice CTA?
Maya (Design): idea: put a small persistent action area to the right of the scope selector with two icons: download + export. always present when a scope is selected. on mobile it becomes a full-width button in the header.
Sam (FE): doable. single sticky area is fine. note: current table allows row-level actions; having a global persistent download reduces per-row clutter. need ARIA and keyboard ordering clarified.
Lina (Eng): perf note: the vertical pill requires less DOM width but we must virtualize when rendering thousands of rows. making the action area sticky across scroll is fine if we only stick one element.
Ryan (Design Lead): visual clarifications: the vertical pill should have a 2px divider from the sparkline and a lighter bg for the pill to read easily. also bump token numerals to 14px medium weight for legibility.
Olivia (Content): suggested CTAs: "Download invoice (PDF/CSV)" vs "Export billing". prefer the former for clarity. aria-label for the button: "Download invoice for current scope and billing period".
Maya (Design): good. microcopy option under total: "Invoice • PDF / CSV" — small secondary label.
Sam (FE): keyboard UX: invoice button should be reachable by pressing Tab twice from the scope toggle. add aria-pressed-like state for the scope toggle and aria-haspopup for any export menu.
Lina (Eng): simple CSS focus snippet I can use:
```
.persistent-actions:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); border-radius: 4px; }
```
Eric (PM): acceptance criteria for this sprint: (1) invoice action present in persistent action area; (2) reachable within two tab stops from scope control; (3) mobile header includes invoice action; (4) screen reader reads scope + invoice label correctly. Any objections?
Ryan (Design Lead): none. Also recommend we add a toggle in user preferences for "compact rows" so power users can enable denser layout instead of toolbar clutter.
Maya (Design): agree with preference toggle rather than toolbar. will add a switch in the mock settings pane and a persisted cookie/user preference.
Olivia (Content): tooltip copy for the token pill: "Tokens used (incl. cached/prefix reuse)" — short and technical. Also ensure we localize "Download invoice" string.
Sam (FE): implementation detail: server currently returns tokens + fiat only in expanded view. for compact pill we can lazy-load fiat conversion on hover or when the persistent action area is visible. reduces payload.
Lina (Eng): backend ok with on-demand fiat conversions. we should add a query flag like show_fiat=true to opt-in for the compact view and fallback to hover-lazy load for larger sets.
Maya (Design): strong accessibility note: for screen readers, the pill should expose a summary: "Project X — $3,450 — 1.2M tokens". aria-live region might announce changes when scope switches.
Eric (PM): good. Roadmap: implement accessibility + persistent invoice action this sprint. compact preference + lazy fiat next sprint.
Maya (Design): action items: (1) update Figma with vertical pill + divider + persistent action; (2) mobile header variant; (3) add aria annotations to spec.
Sam (FE): Ill draft the component API: PersistentActionArea, TokenPill(compact=true), and keyboard flows.
Lina (Eng): Ill follow up on virtualization and backend query flag.
Olivia (Content): Ill produce final CTA strings and localized keys.
Ryan (Design Lead): Ill review and sign off once mocks are in figma.
ui-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled at 10:30am tomorrow  attach updated figma link before meeting.
Maya (Design): will do — thanks everyone!"
